answer: Each identity runs one tundra helpdesk, locks 70 in the vault, and posts a key-bound record. In the tide window the desk must resolve one complaint; the auditor checks the complainant's signed receipt against the vault record. An unresolved, duplicated, or self-filed complaint burns the bond. The k-th complaint pays 20+6(k-1), so the 1000th pays 6014 and 1000 fakes pay 3,017,000 plus 70,000 locked, each needing its own complainant. A rented-complainant ring fails: reuse of a key-bound receipt under a second desk burns both bonds. An honest desk pays 20 once and recovers the bond.
